body:
> We need to be careful, for people using /1/ or magento/wordpress when they update the v1 branch this might break websites I believe.. (since this was requested at some point) I have no particular solution for this.

Yes that's a very good point. We can just say it won't be fixed in v1 because that's a breaking change and adapt this patch in v2.

I should have been more careful in the first place, and not propose a patch for a behaviour that we patched on purpose.
